description: Reads this board runs every period and pushes (all of them, or the ones whose answer changed) as entries [channel][id][status][data] on the watches' channel to the caller that added them.

commands.label: Add a watch
commands.description: Adds or replaces a watch identified by (owner, id); payload is sys_watch_head_t (6 B) followed by the read command (2..48 B).

fields.label: Id
fields.description: Caller's watch id (1..255); adding an existing id replaces it

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Ticks of 10 ms (>= 1): how often the read runs

fields.label: Max silence
fields.description: Ticks of 10 ms. ON_CHANGE sends unchanged value after this many silent ticks (0 = never)

fields.label: Read command
fields.description: Watched read command (2..48 B, dir == CMD_DIR_READ)

commands.label: Remove a watch
commands.description: Removes the watch identified by (origin->src, id).

commands.label: List watches
commands.description: Returns u8 count followed by count sys_watch_info_t records (8 B each).

returns.label: Watch list
returns.description: u8 count followed by count sys_watch_info_t records (8 B each)
